title: Bildad Speaks: God Justly Punishes

questions.question: Who speaks in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Job 8:1 (ESV): "Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:"

questions.question: Does God pervert justice?
questions.explanation: Job 8:3 (ESV): "Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert the right?"

questions.question: If Job seeks God and pleads for mercy, what will happen?
options: He will rouse himself for you and restore your rightful habitation
questions.correctAnswer: He will rouse himself for you and restore your rightful habitation
questions.explanation: Job 8:5–6 (ESV): "If you will seek God... surely then he will rouse himself for you..."

questions.question: Though your beginning was small, what about your latter days?
options: Your latter days will be very great
questions.correctAnswer: Your latter days will be very great
questions.explanation: Job 8:7 (ESV): "And though your beginning was small, your latter days will be very great."

questions.question: What will God not do to a blameless man?
questions.explanation: Job 8:20 (ESV): "Behold, God will not reject a blameless man, nor take the hand of evildoers."

questions.question: Who should Job ask for wisdom?
questions.explanation: Job 8:8 (ESV): "For inquire, please, of bygone ages, and consider what the fathers have found;"

questions.question: Why do we know nothing?
options: For we are but of yesterday
questions.correctAnswer: For we are but of yesterday
questions.explanation: Job 8:9 (ESV): "for we are but of yesterday and know nothing, for our days on earth are a shadow."

questions.question: Can papyrus grow where there is no marsh?
questions.explanation: Job 8:11 (ESV): "Can papyrus grow where there is no marsh? Can reeds flourish where there is no water?"

questions.question: What is the confident assurance of the godless?
questions.explanation: Job 8:14 (ESV): "his confidence is severed, and his trust is a spider's web."

questions.question: What happens when he leans against his house?
questions.explanation: Job 8:15 (ESV): "He leans against his house, but it does not stand; he lays hold of it, but it does not endure."

questions.question: What does Bildad say about Job's children's death?
options: He has delivered them into the hand of their transgression
questions.correctAnswer: He has delivered them into the hand of their transgression
questions.explanation: Job 8:4 (ESV): "If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their transgression."

questions.question: He is a lush plant before the sun, and his shoots spread over his what?
questions.explanation: Job 8:16 (ESV): "He is a lush plant before the sun, and his shoots spread over his garden."

questions.question: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him saying what?
questions.explanation: Job 8:18 (ESV): "If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, 'I have never seen you.'"

questions.question: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the what others will spring?
questions.explanation: Job 8:19 (ESV): "Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the soil others will spring."

questions.question: Those who hate you will be clothed with what?
questions.explanation: Job 8:22 (ESV): "Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more."

key_verse_text: And though your beginning was small, your latter days will be very great.
